mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equities, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.7% over two consecutive months signals weakening labor market conditions, which reduces inflationary pressure and increases the likelihood of future monetary policy easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts below 1000 thousand units over two consecutive months signals a contraction in residential investment, which reduces demand-side momentum and increases the probability of a near-term policy response, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 110.0 for two consecutive months signals a contraction in real output, which increases the likelihood of monetary policy accommodation and reduces inflation expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signal a broad-based weakening in demand, which increases the probability of a policy response and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < 1000 and RSAFS < 380000 in same month
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 2.0% combined with a CPI reading above 215.0 signals a tightening monetary cycle amid persistent inflation, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is above -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate above 5.6% and a decline in non-farm payrolls below 137000 thousand signals a labor market slowdown, which increases the likelihood of policy accommodation and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 1-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below 380000 million dollars combined with a contraction in GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.5% annualized signals a weakening demand environment, which increases the probability of fiscal or monetary stimulus and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: demand contraction with weak GDP growth
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
